proves.claim: The two submit files whose node:fs imports live in generated child scripts are exempt from the fs lint by exact path, and a sibling file is not.

gate.logic-adapter-lints-fs.generated-ch.why: Without this case the exemption could widen to other files, or a regression could count generated-script imports again and block the migration ceilings.

proves.claim: The fs lint run over the real checkout names neither exempt generated-script file.

gate.logic-adapter-lints-fs.real-tree-ge.why: Without this case the exemption could pass its unit case yet the registered static row would still fail on the real tree.
